restraints.method: One tie on intact insulation at EACH endpoint, supported by the Deck; not bare copper, not the lever, not the electrical contact.
restraints.install: Thread loose ties through the bare Deck before electronics. Add wires after all WAGO bodies are restrained. Cut/replace ties for removal.

supported_seats.rule: Tighten by hand only to seat intact PVC in the printed groove; do not crush insulation. Do not use the electrical cage as the strain anchor. Verify actual PVC/print fit phase2.

assembly: Install Deck and route six loose ties before populated carrier/cassette.
Place DATA WAGO blocks at their existing paired slots, mouths towards centre (+Y for south row, -Y for north row).
Form blue stationary bridges, mark both ends W007/W011/W012, preserve port roles; route above P_FRONT/G2 only at specified raised lanes.
Seat the insulation at all six integral saddles; upper routes stay above their specified crossings. Thread T18I width2.5/thickness1.2 through both slots; lock head underneath Deck.
Dry-fit insulated lengths plus two actual housing strip lengths. Fit one bare untinned strand bundle per cage and close levers.
Tighten six ties on insulation only, retain broad bends; excess purchase stock stays outside robot. Test continuity and 12 IDs in phase2.
Nominal manufacturer221-415 strip length11mm. Confirm delivered221-415 marking before stripping; do NOT apply the reserve28mm as a strip length.
stock: Existing7m purchase minimum; three blanks provisionally200mm each. Trim on unpowered dry fit, never coil unused metres inside the body.
